items: 【Compatible Remote Models】Compatible with All 2019-2025 LG Smart TVs with voice and pointer function. It serves as a perfect replacement for LG smart remotes, including MR25GA/GN,MR24GA/GN,MR23GA/GN, MR22GA/GN, MR21GA/GC, MR20GA, MR19BA, MR18BA, AKB76039902, AKB76043102, and AKB75855501, etc. (Notice: this remote only compatible with 2019-2025 LG TVs that support voice control. It doesn't work with cable boxes.)

【Easy to Pair】Just insert 2*AA batteries to the remote.point the remote toward the TV, Then press the Wheel (OK). The remote control will be registered automatically, and the pairing completion message is displayed on the TV screen

items.label: 【With Voice Control/ Magic Pointer Function】
items.value: Pair the remote with your LG TV to activate advanced voice and pointer functions. Enjoy voice control and quick access to services like Netflix, Disney+, and LG Channels with 6 shortcuts hotkeys. Use your voice to search and stream movies, sports, and TV shows!

items: 【1 Year Full Warranty】We offer a full 1-year warranty, ensuring you're fully protected for an entire year. If you need any product support, please find your order in the order history, clicking "View order details" and "Ask Product Question".
